profile.summary: David-driscoll is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in TypeScript, particularly in advanced type systems and type guards. Their contributions to Moment.js focus on enhancing type safety and clarity for date/time manipulation APIs. The developer demonstrates strong skills in designing robust type definitions and optimizing type systems for library-level use. While their contributions are confined to Moment.js and TypeScript, they show deep understanding of type narrowing, unit typing, and API design clarity. No evidence of frontend frameworks, backend systems, or broader JavaScript ecosystem involvement is observed.
skill_evidence: PR #1: Introduces `isMoment`, `isDate`, `isDuration` type guards for runtime type narrowing in Moment.js
PR #2: Adds `UnitOfTime` type to enforce type safety in Moment.js date unit accessors
PR #4: Splits `UnitOfTime` into `DurationUnit` and `MomentUnit` for granular type clarity, with self-documenting notes
PR titles/descriptions explicitly label contributions as TypeScript-related improvements
All PRs modify type definitions rather than runtime behavior, indicating library-level focus
PR #4 includes a note about seeking feedback on type naming, showing API design awareness
No evidence of React/Vue/Node.js/Express/etc. in PRs or repository context
Type guards demonstrated via `if (moment.isMoment(m)) { ... }` pattern in PR #1
